question.text: What is the cooling period before a company can undertake another buyback after the expiry of the previous buyback period?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI Buyback Regulations, no company shall make any offer of buyback within a period of one year reckoned from the date of expiry of the buyback period of the preceding offer of buyback. The Trap: 6 months sounds plausible as many SEBI regulations use 6-month periods (e.g., lock-in periods), but the buyback cooling period is specifically 1 year.
